notes.title: Small changes of the first day
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Small changes of the first day

-Changed the speed of the turret movement

-Changed the delay time of the lasers

-Fixed the error with the country toy

-Decreased the number of spiders in the 2nd room

-Optimized the 2nd room

-Fixed some small bugs

-Corrected localization


Thank you to everyone who played, I will be very glad to your feedback, also visit our discord channel
